description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasController class, specifically testing the parsing of snapshot parameters such as format, quality, and maxWidth.

classes.name: CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the behavior of snapshot parameter parsing in CanvasController.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsDefaultsToJpeg
methods.description: Tests that the default snapshot format is JPEG when null is passed.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesPng
methods.description: Tests parsing of PNG format with specified maxWidth.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesJpegAliases
methods.description: Tests that 'jpeg' and 'jpg' aliases are correctly interpreted as JPEG format.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsClampsQuality
methods.description: Tests that the quality parameter is clamped within expected bounds.
